document.name: Honeycomb CDW · 84 points
document.summary: Honeycomb CDW · 84 points. Half-filled 32-site honeycomb extended Hubbard model, periodic boundaries; DMET with FCI impurity solver and 1 x 2 impurity. All selected points have saved convergence and quality-pass flags. CDW cohort through refinement round 2; later points excluded. AFM/CDW describe initialization protocols; opposite-seed and accepted external results are retained. Settings evolved during the scan. These self-consistent solutions do not establish a ground-state phase diagram. Alternating double occupancy is |(D_A-D_B)/2|; correlations cover 24 of 48 bonds.
